title: Oracle Universe: Oracle19c DBA: a 9-in-1 Package, HML
subtitle: Oracle Universe: Oracle19c DBA: a 9-in-1 Package
descriptionHtml:
1. Oracle19c DBA Part 1

Architecture, Implementation, Database Management, Tablespace (TBS) Management, Files Management

2. Oracle19c DBA Part 2

Schema Management: Tables, Indexes, Users, Privileges, Roles

3. Oracle19c DBA Backup & Recovery

Logical Backup – Data Pump, Physical Backup & Recovery, RMAN, use cases galore

4. Oracle19c DBA Performance Tuning

5 Key Areas, 20 Bottlenecks, SQL Tuning, Overview of 5 Tools, Detailed Coverage of 2 Tools

5. Oracle19c RAC – Real Application Clusters

Architecture, Implementation, RAC & Database Management, and more

6. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)

Architecture, Components, Compute Services, Storage Services, Account Management, Connectivity & Working with OCI

7. Oracle Autonomous Database on OCI

Architecture, Characteristics, Cost Estimation, Provisioning, Connectivity & Working, Backup & Recovery, Cloning, and more

8. Oracle Exadata Overview on OCI

Architecture, Components, Storage Servers, Database Systems, Storage Systems

9. Oracle19c DBA on AWS Cloud RDS

Architecture, Provisioning, RDS Management, Database Management, Backup & Recovery, and more

A Comprehensive Oracle DBA Learning Package

A comprehensive package designed to ReFresh and build in-depth Oracle DBA knowledge, covering both On-Premises and Cloud environments.

The program includes Online Live Guidance Sessions with Mohan Kumar S., providing practical guidance across the different Oracle DBA technologies and platforms. Choose sessions on weekdays, weekends, or both.
